availableCommands.name: compact
availableCommands.description: Compact the conversation context

availableCommands.name: status
availableCommands.description: Show current session status

availableCommands.name: usage
availableCommands.description: Show session token usage

availableCommands.name: mcp
availableCommands.description: Show MCP server status

availableCommands.name: tasks
availableCommands.description: List background tasks

availableCommands.name: help
availableCommands.description: Show available ACP commands

availableCommands.name: check-kimi-code-docs
availableCommands.description: Answer questions about the Kimi Code product using the official documentation — CLI usage, configuration, slash commands, features, membership and quota, API onboarding, third-party tool setup, and error codes. Use when the user asks how Kimi Code works, how to set something up, or what a Kimi Code error message means.

availableCommands.name: custom-theme
availableCommands.description: Create or edit a kimi-code custom color theme — a JSON file under the resolved KIMI_CODE_HOME data directory that recolors the TUI. Use when the user wants their own theme, asks for a specific palette or mood, or wants to tweak an existing custom theme's colors.

availableCommands.name: import-from-cc-codex
availableCommands.description: Import Claude Code and Codex instructions, skills, and MCP settings into Kimi Code.

availableCommands.name: mcp-config
availableCommands.description: Configure MCP servers and handle MCP OAuth login.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill
availableCommands.description: Discover and reorganize the skill inventory into hierarchical sub-skill bundles. Use when the user asks to review, group, or consolidate skills into a parent bundle.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.consolidate
availableCommands.description: Apply an approved sub-skill grouping by moving user-specified skills into a parent bundle, with timestamped backups of every modified directory.

availableCommands.name: sub-skill.review
availableCommands.description: Analyze the available skill set and recommend candidate groups that could be consolidated into sub-skill bundles. Read-only — proposes a plan, does not move files.

availableCommands.name: update-config
availableCommands.description: Inspect or edit kimi-code's own config — `config.toml` (model, provider, permission, hooks) and `tui.toml` (theme, editor, notifications, auto-update). Use when the user asks what a setting does, wants to change one, or needs to fix a deprecated config key / environment variable warning.

availableCommands.name: write-goal
availableCommands.description: Help the user craft a well-specified `<PATH> objective for goal mode — turn a rough intention into a completion contract with a clear finish line, proof, boundaries, and stop rule. Use when the user asks for help writing, refining, or improving a goal.

availableCommands.name: skill:branch-pr
availableCommands.description: Create Gentle AI pull requests with issue-first checks. Trigger: creating, opening, or preparing PRs for review.

availableCommands.name: skill:chained-pr
availableCommands.description: Trigger: PRs over 400 lines, stacked PRs, review slices. Split oversized changes into chained PRs that protect review focus.

availableCommands.name: skill:cognitive-doc-design
availableCommands.description: Design docs that reduce cognitive load. Trigger: writing guides, READMEs, RFCs, onboarding, architecture, or review-facing docs.

availableCommands.name: skill:comment-writer
availableCommands.description: Write warm, direct collaboration comments. Trigger: PR feedback, issue replies, reviews, Slack messages, or GitHub comments.

availableCommands.name: skill:find-skills
availableCommands.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

availableCommands.name: skill:gentle-ai-bench
availableCommands.description: Trigger: bench, journey, journeys, driven mode, gentle-ai-bench, journey corpus, j-numbers, bench axis. Author and verify gentle-ai bench journeys; go test ./bench never proves driven execution.

availableCommands.name: skill:go-testing
availableCommands.description: Trigger: Go tests, go test coverage, Bubbletea teatest, golden files. Apply focused Go testing patterns.

availableCommands.name: skill:issue-creation
availableCommands.description: Create and triage GitHub issues from repository evidence. Trigger: issue creation, bug reports, feature requests, or issue approval.

availableCommands.name: skill:judgment-day
availableCommands.description: Trigger: judgment day, dual review, adversarial review, juzgar. Run explicit blind dual review with at most two scoped fix/re-judgment rounds.

availableCommands.name: skill:rdd-defect-workflow
availableCommands.description: Trigger: RDD, receipt-driven development, review authority, receipt/lineage, correction/recovery, delivery gate/kill switch, bounded review defects. Guide work.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-apply
availableCommands.description: Implement SDD tasks from specs and design. Trigger: orchestrator launches apply for one or more change tasks.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-archive
availableCommands.description: Archive an SDD change honestly by syncing delta specs and preserving its artifacts. Trigger: orchestrator launches archive.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-design
availableCommands.description: Create the SDD technical design and architecture approach. Trigger: orchestrator launches design for a change.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-explore
availableCommands.description: Explore SDD ideas before committing to a change. Trigger: orchestrator launches exploration or requirement clarification.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-init
availableCommands.description: Trigger: sdd init, iniciar sdd, openspec init. Initialize SDD context, testing capabilities, registry, and persistence.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-onboard
availableCommands.description: Walk users through the SDD workflow on the real codebase. Trigger: orchestrator launches onboarding for the full SDD cycle.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-propose
availableCommands.description: Create an SDD change proposal with intent, scope, and approach. Trigger: orchestrator launches proposal work for a change.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-research
availableCommands.description: Trigger: SDD research, external evidence, source-backed research. Investigate optional questions using available authorized sources.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-spec
availableCommands.description: Write SDD delta specs with requirements and scenarios. Trigger: orchestrator launches spec work for a change.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-tasks
availableCommands.description: Break an SDD change into implementation tasks. Trigger: orchestrator launches task planning for a change.

availableCommands.name: skill:sdd-verify
availableCommands.description: Trigger: explicitly requested SDD verification. Run optional practical diagnostics against available implementation and artifacts.

availableCommands.name: skill:skill-creator
availableCommands.description: Trigger: new skills, agent instructions, documenting AI usage patterns. Create LLM-first skills with valid frontmatter.

availableCommands.name: skill:skill-improver
availableCommands.description: Trigger: improve skills, audit skills, refactor skills, skill quality. Audit and upgrade existing LLM-first skills.

availableCommands.name: skill:skill-registry
availableCommands.description: Trigger: update skills, skill registry, actualizar skills, after skill changes. Index available skills by trigger and path.

availableCommands.name: skill:systemic-issue-triage
availableCommands.description: Trigger: new issue, bug report, triage, backlog, issue flood, community report, root cause, dead-end, blocked user. Attack issues by root class, never one-by-one; fixes must shrink the system, not grow it.

availableCommands.name: skill:work-unit-commits
availableCommands.description: Plan commits as reviewable work units. Trigger: implementation, commit splitting, chained PRs, or keeping tests and docs with code.
